# V12 results (generated by report12.py; measured on the lab PC)

V12 = YOLOv9-S-TI-Lite 640 fine-tuned from frozen V10 (V10 settings, LR 3e-5, 8 epochs) in 3 variants on manifests_v11 data: a_data (V10 pipeline), b_zoom (mild zoom-out + camera degradations), c_zoom_paste (b + small-flame paste). Then optionally fine-tuned on owner recordings. Rules: PROTOCOL_V12.md.
